description: Hand-authored source question set for the demo-2 session. scripts/generate-demo-2-polis-fixture.mjs combines this file with demo_2_persona_stances.json to emit demo_2_question_seed.json and demo_2_polis_data.json. Loadings/bias are generation-time metadata and are stripped from the generated fixtures.

session.title: Living With Artificial Minds
session.summary: Sixty-two historical figures deliberate how humanity should govern, work beside, and live with artificial intelligence.

questions.prompt: Frontier AI labs must prove a system is safe before release, the way we treat new medicines.
questions.keyTension: Pre-market proof versus iterate-and-patch: which failure mode costs more?
questions.author: JRobertOppenheimer

questions.prompt: A global pause on the largest AI training runs would do more good than harm.
questions.keyTension: Coordination fantasy or necessary brake — can rivals ever stop together?
questions.author: RachelCarson

questions.prompt: Present-day harms — bias, fraud, displacement — deserve priority over speculative extinction scenarios.
questions.keyTension: Near-term justice and long-term survival compete for the same attention
questions.author: FrederickDouglass

questions.prompt: How likely is it that advanced AI causes a civilization-scale catastrophe in the next 50 years?
questions.keyTension: Expert estimates span two orders of magnitude, and policy follows the estimate
questions.author: vonNeumann

questions.prompt: Dangerous-capability research should be published openly so defenses can keep pace.
questions.keyTension: Sunlight hardens defenses — and hands out blueprints
questions.author: MarieCurie

questions.prompt: AI powerful enough to reshape economies should answer to international institutions, not national governments alone.
questions.keyTension: Treaty-speed governance chasing venture-speed technology
questions.author: EleanorRoosevelt

questions.prompt: The public, not technical experts, should set the goals AI systems are allowed to pursue.
questions.keyTension: Legitimacy versus competence at the frontier
questions.author: JeanJacquesRousseau

questions.prompt: Regulators should be able to audit the training data and weights of any widely deployed model.
questions.keyTension: Accountability presses against trade secrets and security
questions.author: JamesMadison

questions.prompt: Who should hold the final say when an AI system's deployment is contested?
questions.keyTension: Every candidate authority has failed somewhere before
questions.author: Hamilton

questions.prompt: 'Move fast and fix problems later' has served humanity well, and AI should be no exception.
questions.keyTension: The industrial playbook meets a technology that may not forgive patches
questions.author: HenryFord

questions.prompt: If AI automates most labor, universal basic income stops being charity and becomes infrastructure.
questions.keyTension: Who owns the dividend of automation?
questions.author: FDR

questions.prompt: Companies that profit from automation owe retraining and transition support to the workers they displace.
questions.keyTension: Private windfalls, socialized adjustment costs
questions.author: LechWalesa

questions.prompt: Within a generation, AI will create more meaningful work than it destroys.
questions.keyTension: Every past technology wave eventually paid off — is this one different?
questions.author: AdamSmith

questions.prompt: Which policy best cushions an AI-driven labor shock?
questions.keyTension: Cash, jobs, ownership, skills, or patience — pick your parachute
questions.author: KarlMarx

options.label: Let markets adapt on their own

questions.prompt: How much of today's paid work will machines do better than people within 25 years?
questions.keyTension: Capability forecasts drive every downstream labor policy
questions.author: JamesWatt

questions.prompt: Platforms should carry legal liability for synthetic media that deceives people at scale.
questions.keyTension: Deterrence versus chilling legitimate speech
questions.author: Voltaire

questions.prompt: AI-generated political advertising should be banned outright during election seasons.
questions.keyTension: Protecting the vote versus policing expression
questions.author: Lincoln

questions.prompt: Provenance labels — knowing what is synthetic — will do more than takedowns ever could.
questions.keyTension: Transparency as remedy versus label fatigue
questions.author: Franklin

questions.prompt: Personalized AI feeds fragment shared reality faster than they inform it.
questions.keyTension: Individual relevance versus common ground
questions.author: Plato

questions.prompt: What would it take for you to trust information produced by an AI?
questions.keyTension: Trust criteria differ more than truth criteria
questions.author: CharlesDarwin

questions.prompt: An AI that convincingly reports suffering deserves the benefit of the doubt.
questions.keyTension: Moral caution versus anthropomorphic error
questions.author: AlanTuring

questions.prompt: A deep friendship with an AI companion can be as genuine as one with a person.
questions.keyTension: Comfort at scale versus simulated intimacy
questions.author: AdaLovelace

questions.prompt: Designing AI companions to maximize emotional dependence should be illegal.
questions.keyTension: Consumer protection inside the most private relationships
questions.author: MahatmaGandhi

questions.prompt: How comfortable are you with AI tutors helping raise the next generation of children?
questions.keyTension: Infinite patience at the cost of human example
questions.author: Confucius

questions.prompt: Where is the one line a machine should never be allowed to cross with a human being?
questions.keyTension: Everyone draws a line; almost no one draws the same one
questions.author: MarcusAurelius

questions.prompt: Open-sourcing powerful model weights is safer than trusting a few labs to hold them.
questions.keyTension: Many hands versus loose weapons
questions.author: GraceHopper

questions.prompt: A handful of private companies controlling frontier AI frightens me more than AI itself.
questions.keyTension: Which is the threat: the tool or its owners?
questions.author: SimonBolivar

questions.prompt: Compute for AI should be treated like a public utility, with guaranteed fair access.
questions.keyTension: Innovation markets versus intelligence as infrastructure
questions.author: SunYatSen

questions.prompt: What worries you most about concentrated AI power?
questions.keyTension: Ranking fears reveals more than naming them
questions.author: OttoVonBismarck

questions.prompt: A world of many national AIs racing each other is more dangerous than one dominant power.
questions.keyTension: Multipolar chaos versus hegemonic control
questions.author: SunTzu

questions.prompt: Schools should teach students to command AI the way we once taught them to write.
questions.keyTension: Preparing for the world that is, or the one we regret
questions.author: Obama

questions.prompt: Letting students lean on AI for schoolwork hollows out the very thinking school exists to build.
questions.keyTension: Calculator moment or crutch?
questions.author: QueenElizabethI

questions.prompt: A personal AI tutor for every child would close more gaps than a decade of classroom reform.
questions.keyTension: Scalable attention versus human mentorship
questions.author: NormanBorlaug

questions.prompt: How much of a student's grade should rest on work done entirely without AI?
questions.keyTension: Measuring the student or the student-machine team
questions.author: Washington

questions.prompt: What single human capacity must schools protect, whatever AI learns to do?
questions.keyTension: Naming the irreplaceable is harder than praising it
questions.author: AlbertEinstein

questions.prompt: Used well, AI that maps where citizens actually agree could heal more division than it creates.
questions.keyTension: Consensus discovery versus manufactured consent
questions.author: NelsonMandela

questions.prompt: Citizens' assemblies briefed by AI would govern better than career politicians.
questions.keyTension: Amateur wisdom amplified versus institutional experience
questions.author: SusanBAnthony

questions.prompt: Where should AI help democracy first?
questions.keyTension: The first foothold shapes every later one
questions.author: Jefferson

options.label: Nowhere — keep AI out of democracy

questions.prompt: How much influence should AI systems have over public policy decisions by 2050?
questions.keyTension: Advisory tool, drafting partner, or voting member?
questions.author: WinstonChurchill

questions.prompt: If an AI moderated your town's next public meeting, what one rule must it obey?
questions.keyTension: One rule reveals what each person fears losing
questions.author: JamesMadison
